title: Prototype-guided Bilateral Alignment Multimodal Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.38925v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal federated learning (MFL) has emerged as a pivotal paradigm for leveraging distributed data to enhance model performance. However, existing methods predominantly rely on idealized assumptions of model homogeneity and balanced modality distributions, rendering them ill-suited for practical scenarios characterized by heterogeneous client architectures and severe modality imbalance. To address these challenges, we propose a \textbf{M}ultimodal \textbf{Fed}erated learning Prototype-guided Bilateral Alignment (MFedPBA) framework. MFedPBA facilitates robust knowledge synergy through a dual alignment mechanism: (i) at the feature level, it aligns heterogeneous feature spaces via a projection encoder optimized by contrastive learning and the Gromov-Wasserstein distance; (ii) at the decision level, it employs an entropy-weighted aggregation of naturally aligned logit prototypes. translated_title: 原型引导的双边对齐多模态联邦学习
translated_abstract: 多模态联邦学习已成为利用分布式数据提升模型性能的关键范式。然而，现有方法主要依赖于模型同质性和模态分布均衡的理想化假设，使其难以适用于以异构客户端架构和严重模态不平衡为特征的实际场景。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了多模态联邦学习原型引导双边对齐框架。MFedPBA通过双重对齐机制促进稳健的知识协同：（i）在特征层面，通过由对比学习和Gromov-Wasserstein距离优化的投影编码器来对齐异构特征空间；（ii）在决策层面，采用自然对齐的logit原型的熵加权聚合。这一新颖设计通过联合解决上述问题，实现了稳健的多模态联邦学习。
tldr: 提出了MFedPBA框架，通过特征层面基于对比学习和Gromov-Wasserstein距离的投影编码器对齐、以及决策层面熵加权的logit原型聚合双重机制，实现了异构客户端架构和严重模态不平衡场景下的稳健多模态联邦学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MFedPBA, a prototype-guided bilateral alignment framework that achieves robust multimodal federated learning under heterogeneous client architectures and severe modality imbalance through feature-level alignment via contrastive learning and Gromov-Wasserstein distance optimization, combined with decision-level entropy-weighted aggregation of naturally aligned logit prototypes.
